narrative.overview: Native farm-floor work uses scannable state, clear actions and familiar iOS interaction. Quiet, utilitarian and data-forward are source-based assumptions, not confirmed brand language.
keyCharacteristics: Status expressed in text as well as color
dos: Do use semantic adaptive colors and verify both appearances.
Do preserve Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, Reduce Motion and 44-point targets.
Do show honest offline, stale, unavailable and error states.
donts: Don't use color alone to communicate status.
Don't replace native controls or gestures merely for visual novelty.
Don't treat an incumbent example as proof of contrast or device behavior; validate the affected surface.
